data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Alexandros', meaning 'defender of the people'. In the New Testament, St. Alexander the Fighter was a Roman soldier and Christian martyr. The name Alejandrina carries the meaning “Defender of the People” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alejandrina usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
